Method of Attack: Injecting malicious data into the buffers that victim program unwillingly uses during speculative execution
Control flow hijacking by tricking the victim into speculatively executing a function of the attacker's choosing
Discoverer: Jo Van Bulck and his team
Attack Vector: Spraying the LFBs with the address of a malicious function
Inducing faulting or assisted load in the victim program
Transient injection of attacker's value into code gadgets
